subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.

The salesman informed the customers that if they had any questions, they could __drop a line.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (send a brief letter)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"drop a line"** is an idiom that means to send a brief letter or message to someone, often as a means of staying in touch. (एक छोटा संदेश भेजना)

 
 
• **Example: **If you ever visit Paris, don’t forget to drop me a line!
 
 
 
• **"Send a brief letter"** accurately captures the meaning of the idiom "drop a line," which is why it is the correct answer. (एक छोटा पत्र भेजना)
 
 
• **Example: **The author promised to send a brief letter to his fans every month.
 
 
 
• Hence, the phrase "drop a line" can be substituted with "send a brief letter" without changing the meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (send a brief letter)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2 (complain against him)** (उसके खिलाफ शिकायत करना): This option implies reporting dissatisfaction or issues about the salesman, which does not align with the context of "drop a line."

 
 
• **Example:** The customer decided to complain against the manager for poor service.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 (call his secretary)** (उसकी सचिव को कॉल करना): This option suggests making a phone call, which is not the meaning of the idiom "drop a line."
 
 
• **Example:** If you need more information, you can call his secretary for assistance.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 (come back with the items)** (सामान के साथ वापस आना): This option implies returning with purchased goods, which is unrelated to the context of "drop a line."
 
 
• **Example:** The customer promised to come back with the items once the payment was made.
 
 

3c:Tae9,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
